imugap.maps

⚠️ Under construction. The scope of this package is still being figured out. The name in the DESCRIPTION is imugap.maps; the repo is imugap-map. The README will get more specific as the surface area stabilizes.

A sibling R package to imuGAP that holds tools which depend on imuGAP but don’t belong inside the modeling package itself. The DESCRIPTION calls it “CLI and Geospatial Tools for imuGAP” — the CLI half is real today, the geospatial half is aspirational.

What’s here today

A thin wrapper around imuGAP::imuGAP() packaged as a shell CLI:

  • install_cli() — drops a symlink in ~/.local/bin so imugap is on PATH.
  • inst/scripts/imugap.R — the script the symlink points at. Reads observations.{csv,rds}, populations.{csv,rds}, locations.{csv,rds} from an input directory, runs imuGAP’s canonicalize + sampler, writes fit.rds (a raw stanfit) to the output directory.

Usage:

imugap input/ output/

That’s it. No post-processing, no aggregation, no geospatial functions.

What might land here later

A few directions have been discussed; none are committed:

  • Post-processing helpers that turn a stanfit into the tabular shapes downstream consumers (e.g. the measles dashboard) need.
  • Geospatial joins between school-level model output and standardized location data from USImmunityProfiles.
  • CLI subcommands beyond “run the model.”

We expect the scope to firm up as the dashboard’s CSV consumption work (measles-dashboard#20) and the broader release prep on imuGAP land.

Installation 

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ACCIDDA/imugap-map")

Requires imuGAP, which is currently a GitHub-only dependency (declared under Remotes: in DESCRIPTION). Once imuGAP is on CRAN that line can go away.

Repository status

  • CI: in progress on #7. Once that merges, R-CMD-check + pkgdown run on every PR; man/ is regenerated from roxygen comments in CI and is not tracked in git.
  • Issues and discussion are tracked in the issue tracker.
